'''{{PAGENAME}}''', '''Masch Rai''', and '''Ordega Rai''' are three Gladiator Brothers who can be found at the small Gladiator camp in [[Maroonwood]] in Sanguis Plateaus, Rinascita.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;After {{Quest|By Sun's Burning Hand}}
:;'''Gaea Rai''' All three of us returned safely from the great battle. It's more than we could've wished for.
	
:'''Gaea Rai:''' {{Rover}}, do you have a moment to give us some pointers? We've been debriefing the last hunt, but we can't seem to reach a consensus on what mattered most.
:{{DIcon}} Of course.
::'''Gaea Rai:''' Most grateful! Well then, we'd like to hear your judgment on which of us got it right.
::'''Gaea Rai:''' In my opinion, speed wins fights—strike before your prey even realizes you're there. Kill fast, end faster. Drag it out, and things can easily go sideways.
::'''Ordega Rai:''' You're oversimplifying it, brother! What if the first strike fails? Then what? It's all about following a strategy. That's what brings people back.
::'''Masch Rai:''' No, no, you're thinking too small. A hunt isn't fought by one warrior! It's about the unit. Coordinating between squads. Obeying orders. That's what ensures victory.
::'''Gaea Rai:''' But {{Rover}} has achieved many heroic feats by themselves! There's an entire army in {{MC|m=him|f=her}}!
::'''Ordega Rai:''' You idiot! This is the champion of the Agon we're talking about! Not all Resonators are built the same!
::'''Masch Rai:''' Enough arguing... Let {{Rover}} tell us the answer.

::{{DIcon}} Hit first and hit hard!
:::'''Gaea Rai:''' Aha, great minds think alike! You hear that, boys? You hit 'em fast and you hit 'em hard. Starting tomorrow, the two of you will be in for some power training!
::{{DIcon}} Nothing will matter if you're dead!
:::'''Ordega Rai:''' Well, said! You can't claim glory from the grave.
::{{DIcon}} Teamwork makes the dream work!
:::'''Masch Rai:''' Like I said, instead of focusing on individual tactics, we should strengthen our coordination in the field!
::{{DIcon}} None of that matters.
:::'''Gaea Rai:''' None of them? Are you implying... we're not thinking big enough?!
::'''Gaea Rai:''' We greatly appreciate your advice. We'll take some time to think this through...
:{{DIcon}} Maybe next time.
----
;After {{Quest|Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides}}
:;'''Gaea Rai''' {{Rover}}! Welcome back!
:'''Gaea Rai:''' May howls of triumph follow you, Honorable {{Rover}}!
:'''Gaea Rai:''' Do you remember the guidance you once gave us?
:'''Gaea Rai:''' Thanks to your instructions, when the disaster struck, the three of us managed to survive and even claim victory!
:'''Gaea Rai:''' It was through your efforts that we set aside our differences and worked together to overcome it.
:'''Gaea Rai:''' We are truly grateful.
{{Dialogue End}}
